title: Page references a flow that is not in the org
detail: Page "Test" (/test) embeds flow Portal_Tracker_Test. It was not found among active flows in AmplifyDev1, so the page will show a flow error.
evidence: View Test content.json; FlowDefinitionView query returned no row.

title: "Make a payment" menu link points at the wrong page
detail: Navigation menu Primary_Onboarding_Contact_3T labels an item "Make a payment" but links to /CheckPasswordResetEmail (the Check Password Reset Email page). Primary Onboarding contacts on tier 3, 3T and 3+ accounts will not reach the payment page from the menu.

title: Logged-in contacts with no contact type get no mobile menu on inner pages
detail: In the inner-page theme layout, the mobile (hamburger) menu rule for "Guest/Generic" has criterion 4 set to "Contains Professional Development Contact" where its desktop counterpart says "NotContains". 4 persona/tier combinations resolve to no mobile menu.
evidence: themeLayout scopedHeaderAndFooter, hamburger container rule variation "Guest/Generic"

title: Home page: mobile menu differs from desktop menu for Technical + PD contacts
detail: Tier 3-family contacts with Technical + Professional Development types get Technical_PD_Contact on desktop but Technical_Materials_PD_Contact on the mobile menu, which adds Orders and shipping.
evidence: themeLayout Home_Page hamburger container variation "TC + PD (3T)"

title: Tier 3+ with Technical + Materials + PD contact types loses the Professional Development link on inner pages
detail: The "TC + MC + PD (3T)" desktop rule lists tier "3T" twice and omits "3+", so tier 3+ falls through to Technical_Materials_Contact. The mobile menu and home page do include it.
evidence: themeLayout scopedHeaderAndFooter, bar container variation "TC + MC + PD (3T)", criteria 6 and 7

title: Typo in a personalisation rule
detail: One audience criterion on the outer navigation wrapper reads "Technical Conact". It can never match.
evidence: themeLayout scopedHeaderAndFooter, navigation menu variation "TC + PD (3T)", criterion 1

title: Professional Development contacts outside tier 3 see the generic menu
detail: A contact whose only type is Professional Development, on an account that is not tier 3, 3T or 3+, has no Professional Development link in the menu or home tiles. This may be intended.

title: Fault handling is mostly centralised
detail: 153 of 178 fault connectors route to the shared Fault Path Screen subflow. Exceptions: CALM Portal | Order Allocation Modal (1 of 9); Community- Material Status v2 (5 of 5); Customer Portal | Create Case from Webform (12 of 12); Customer Portal | Find Requested Username (7 of 7).

title: Order status LWCs are not used by any flow on this site
detail: The repo contains orderStatusFilter, orderStatusFilterShipTo, orderStatusResults, orderStatusResultsTile, orderStatusResultsTileItem, but none of the 29 portal flows place them on a screen. The Shipment Status page uses Community_Material_Status_v2, which has no custom components. They may serve another site or be legacy.

title: Order Allocation Manager LWC is in development
detail: orderAllocationManager is placed on /omp, uses built-in mock data ("replaced by Apex in Phase 2"), and is in no navigation menu. The route has no login requirement.

title: Legacy allocation components remain
detail: allocationsTable_v2, createOAModal and configureModal are still used inside flows; CALM_Create_New_Order_Allocation is only launched by createOAModal.

title: Self-registration is off but the Register page still exists
detail: Network selfRegistration is false. Users are provisioned by back-office flows (see Journey 1).

title: Guest exposure should be confirmed
detail: Most routes (including Submit a PO, Support, Shipment Status, School Scheduling and PD Certificate) use the site default of public access. Whether guests can actually read or write the underlying data depends on the guest user profile and sharing, which this review did not examine.
